buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 50% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 50 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 50 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 50 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Service & Support

AVAILABILITY OF OFFICE OF SERVICE PROVIDER: An office of the Service Provider must be located in the state of Consignee. DOCUMENTARY EVIDENCE TO BE SUBMITTED. 3. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Fixed Deposit Receipt made out or pledged in the name of A/C The Executive Officer,Nagar Panchayat Gosaiganj Ayodhya . The bank should certify on it that the deposit can be withdrawn only on the demand or with the sanction of the pledgee. For release of EMD, the FDR will be released in the favour of the bidder by the Buyer after making endorsement on the back of the FDR duly signed and stamped along with covering letter. Bidder has to upload scanned copy/ proof of the FDR along with bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy to the Buyer within 5 days of Bid End date/ Bid Opening date 4. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 5. Human Resource Service Continuity of resources deployed by Service Provider: Successful Service provider will ensure continuity of any allocated / deployed resources with the prior consent of the buyer department. Deployed resources cannot be replaced by Service Provider without prior approval of buyer. Any replacement will also be provided through Sewayojan Portal only. 6. Human Resource Service Deployment of Existing working / deployed resources: 63 number of Existing working / deployed resources of the procurement department having job satisfactory certificate, will be continued by the successful Service Provider under the new contract also – subject to their consent to the Terms and conditions of new contract concluded on the basis of this bid. 7. Human Resource Service Recruitment mandated through Sewayojan Portal: Recruitment of candidates is mandated through Sewayojan Portal (url:www.sewayojan.up.nic.in). Successful bidder / Service Provider has to select candidates registered on the Sewayojan Portal only for deployment under this contract. As such successful Service provider will have to make available adequate number of candidates / resources registered on sewayojan portal for selection / short listings by the Buyer department For 1 employee selection five times and for 2 or more than 2 employees to be three times, subject to the min of 10 candidates. 8. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Buyer Mentioned Eligibility Criteria: 1. Bidder should have a valid iso certificate 2. Bidder should be registered with the local labour department. 3. Bidder Must be Registered with the Local state, where tender Is published. 4. Bidder should be registered with the MSE in the right category, else its offer will be rejected. 5. Bidder should have registration with Sewayojan portal. 6. Bidder should be Registered with ESI, PF, Last 3 years ESI Return Must be enclosed with the bid Document s, else bidder Offer will be liable for rejection.

7. Bidder must submit a satisfactory work certificate from one of the user departments to whom bidder has s upplied manpower in last 3 preceding years which should be ink singed by the HOD. 8. For electrical manpower bidder has a valid electrical safety license, it must be submitted along with bid do cuments else bidder offer will be rejected. 9. Bidder has to submit last 3 invoices of the related manpower work order which should be self-certified by t he bidder. 10. Emd must be Originally submitted on or before the end of bid to the office, else bid will be liable for rejecti on or bidder will be technically disqualified. 11. Bidder must have experience of at least 85% of manpower required in this bid supplied to last financial ye ar, work order copy must be enclosed with the bid. 12. Bidder must submit an undertaking on notarized stamp paper that if or any of manpower supplied by his a gency found guilty of any corruption, negligence knowingly or unknowingly, any fraud or miscommunicatio n or misbehaviour to any of the office staff, any type of conspiracy towards the department or any staff wil l be replaced within 24 hours and no dues will be paid to the agency. 13. All documents as required in bid will be submitted by the bidder. 14. Department has right to reduce the Qty or increase the qty of manpower during the contract period and ag ency is bound to supply the manpower as per the intimation of the department, apart of that Department h as right to extend the contract period manually after completion of contract till the new contract generate d. 15. Bidder Must Have A Valid ISO 9001 Certification, Certificate Regarding To Occupational Health And Safety Management System, And Certification Regarding Energy Management System And These All Certificates Should Be Issued From International Accreditation Forum 16. Bidder Declaration Required For Residual Undertaking And Delivery Undertaking As Per Bid Terms Separat ely Along With Atc Certificate. 17. Bidder has to submit original screenshot form LIN issued Government Institution. 18. Bidder must be registered on Sewayojan portal and all government rules will be applicable as per Sewayoj an portal. 19. Rates will be applicable as per Government orders time to time. 20. EMD must be submitted in Hardcopy on or before end of technical bid. .
